verdict.rationale: OpenAI's libraries documentation names an official "OpenAI CLI for shell-native workflows" alongside the official SDKs and Agents SDK. That directly answers whether an official CLI exists. However, it is only a single passing mention, with no detail on how to install or use it. Missing for 10: installation and command documentation, auth/config details for the CLI, evidence of agent-friendly features (e.g. machine-readable output), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
